prompt:

Asset type: wide website hero photograph for a Swedish plumbing and energy company.
Primary request: Create one exceptionally natural, premium Swedish bathroom interior photograph. Horizontal 16:9 composition at the largest available resolution.
Scene and subject: On the right third, an impeccable and physically plausible chrome mixer tap above a white ceramic basin, quiet pale grey stone, a warm light oak vanity, and a section of deep forest green tile echoing #284907. Restrained lived-in detail, beautiful real materials, accurate installation and plumbing.
Composition: Reserve the entire left 45% as a pale, subtly lit wall with gentle architectural shadows and no important objects. It must remain visually calm and light enough for a dark website headline overlay added later. All functional bathroom fixtures are toward the right. Natural architectural photography perspective.
Style and light: Photorealistic editorial and real estate photography, soft Nordic daylight, refined but believable residential interior, subtle texture, balanced highlights, natural reflections and a restrained color palette.
Constraints: No people. No text, logos, signs or watermarks. No fantasy fixtures. No oversaturated AI look, no glossy CGI appearance. This is illustrative atmosphere, not documentation of any real company's client project.
